prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — a few quick questions will let me give a targeted recommendation:

- Do you have dental insurance (and which plan)?
- Any preferences (male/female dentist, kids, evening/weekend hours, sedation, language)?
- Which part of Pleasanton are you closest to (zip code or cross-streets)?

If you want to choose the “best” dentist for a routine checkup and cleaning right now, here’s a short, practical checklist and a phone/email script you can use to quickly compare offices.

How to pick a great dentist for a checkup & cleaning
- Check ratings and reviews (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, Zocdoc). Read recent reviews about cleanings, wait times, and staff friendliness.
- Confirm they accept your insurance or offer transparent self-pay prices for prophylaxis (routine cleaning).
- Look for a dentist/hygienist focused on preventive care and patient education.
- Confirm credentials: DDS/DMD, state license, membership in ADA or local dental society.
- Office factors: clean, modern equipment (digital X‑rays), comfortable waiting area, convenient hours.
- Hygienist experience: many patients judge cleanings by the hygienist’s skill and bedside manner.
- New‑patient exam: ask what’s included (exam, X‑rays, cleaning, oral cancer screening).
- Cancellation/no-show policies and appointment availability (how long to get seen).

Questions to ask when you call (script)
“Hi — I’m a new patient and I’m looking for a routine checkup and cleaning. Do you accept [insurance name]? What is the charge for a new‑patient exam with cleaning if I’m self‑pay? What does the new‑patient visit include (X‑rays, oral cancer screening)? How long are routine cleanings scheduled for, and how soon can I get an appointment? Who performs the cleaning — a registered dental hygienist or the dentist? Do you offer evening/weekend appointments?”

Red flags to avoid
- Offices that can’t or won’t confirm insurance coverage or give an estimate.
- Consistently poor recent reviews about pain during cleanings, rushed appointments, or rude staff.
- Very long wait times to get an appointment for routine care.

If you tell me your insurance (or your ZIP code and any preferences), I can suggest several highly rated practices in Pleasanton and draft a short message you can send to clinics to compare availability and price. Which would you prefer?
